NetIncomeLossタグ破損: 2018-2020は妥当(229/259/257百万)だが2021以降0.2-0.3百万と崩壊(タグ/メンバー断絶)。FY2025のop=265.9・tax=63.7からNI≒約200百万と推定されるが、清潔なタグ値が無いためni=null。参考計算のNI=0/accr=-27.5%/FCF転換122761%は全て破損NI起因のノイズで棄却
accr=-5.8はドラフト維持だが破損NIのため正確値は未検証。ただしOCF(FY2025=273.5百万)>推定NI(~200百万)より符号は負(利益の質は良好)で確定=p4判定は独立に成立
fcf=null: CapExタグ不発見。OCF FY2025=273.5百万は堅牢だがcapex控除不能でFCF充填せず(教育サービス業で低capexだが値不明)
cagr=null(ドラフト19.8を棄却): 継続事業体の売上(RevenueFromContract 2018:845.5→2025:1,106.1)CAGRは約3.9%、直近5年(2021→2025)も約5.4%。19.8%は2018年GCU分離前の旧統合体『Revenues』系列を跨いだ値で現事業体では再現不能=誤値より空欄

roict='up'✓(のれん込みROIC 21.3→26.9%上昇)。gmt='up'はGrossProfitタグ不発見で未検証、なおopmは2021:31.5→2025:24.0%と低下傾向のため要確認

acq5=null: PaymentsToAcquireBusinessesは2019:361.2百万(Orbis買収)のみ=6年前で5年窓外。以降の買収タグなし

evidence.erosion: 『new competitors or alliances among competitors may emerge and rapidly acquire significant market share』『competition may intensify as our competitors raise additional capital』→競争激化リスクが継続的に顕在化=emerging(蝕セクション)
evidence.disrupt: 『established companies in other market segments or geographic markets expand into our market』『result in pricing pressure and significantly reduce our revenue』→新規参入・価格圧力で市場構造が不確定=unsettled
evidence.geopol: 『other federal agencies and departments including the SEC, the Internal Revenue Service (IRS), and the Federal Trade Commission (FTC)』『U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs』『90/10 Rule』『Title IV』→米国内単一市場・国内規制のみで海外/地政学エクスポージャーなし=0(軽微)
evidence.p4: 『assessing the risk that a material weakness exists, and testing and evaluating the design and operating effectiveness of internal control』=監査報告の定型文であり実指摘ではない。『Unresolved Staff Comments None』→無限定・指摘なし。accr<0(OCF>NI)と合わせp4=90
evidence.moatW: セグメント別売上: 10-K FY2025(2025-12-31)『The Company has concluded there is one operating segment and one reporting unit』(Number of operating segments = 1)。service revenue 1,106,070千$ の全額が大学パートナー向け教育サービス(単一製品ラインが100%で≥80%)。顧客集中: 『Our dependence on our most significant university partner, with 89.5% and 88.9% of total service revenue for the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024』＝最大顧客GCUが89.5%(≥20%)。パートナー数20校に対し、enrollment 136,239名のうちGCUが131,826名(96.8%)。GCUとのMSAは『60% of GCU's tuition and fee revenue』を受け取る単一契約。(出典: 10-K FY2025 Note—Summary of Significant Accounting Policies / Nature of Business / Business Concentrations, R33・R34) → 独立した堀は1本・単一顧客依存＝50
evidence.dom: 10-K FY2025 Item1 Competition: 『There are dozens of companies that seek to partner with non-profit schools and state universities...』『The largest companies in this sector have historically been Pearson Online Learning Services, Academic Partnerships and 2U, Inc.』『The education services market is changing and expanding. It is highly fragmented and subject to evolving technology...』＝自社は最大手として挙げられず、市場は原本の記述どおり highly fragmented。支配シェアを示す数値開示は10-K内に無し。→ 競争(<40%)＝dom=50
